scripts.title: Fishy Hub | Full Auto Farm, Priorities, Auto Limiteds n More
scripts.features:
This script is a comprehensive automation suite for the Roblox game "Search For The Needle," built on the Obsidian UI library and targeting Chapter 1s map with support for both different difficulty modes. Its core feature is an auto-farm state machine that automatically picks, sells, and collects hay using the optimal owned tool—hand, pitchfork, vacuum, or dynamite—while prioritizing rainbow and mutated hay, collecting dropped hay, and walking to targets with stuck-detection. It also includes auto-upgrades with per-track enable, max-level, and priority controls plus cash-reserve and spend-limit safeguards, auto-purchase of missing tools from the shop, auto-deployment of drones, and gem collection with far-gem walking. Full needle objective support lets it rush toward the needle's position, grab revealed objectives, equip the needle, walk to the farmer, and hand it in automatically. A rich ESP system renders markers and outlines for hay, rainbow and mutated specials, gems, the needle, the farmer, sell points, shop items, players, drones, world objects like the UFO and key, and custom name-matched instances, with configurable distance and marker caps. Extras cover intro/tutorial/outro skipping, camera-shake removal, sound muting, popup hiding, anti-AFK, FPS capping, and a draggable live status HUD showing state, bag count, cash, gems, vacuum heat, and session earnings. Settings persist to disk as JSON, and the whole suite runs through a tabbed UI with a keybind toggle, theme manager, save manager, and clean unload that restores everything it changed.
